title: desktop-app 0.2.0: T50 holo coworker cards (CSS foil, tilt, flip; no new deps)
head: t50-holo-cards
body:
Not a needs-Braden PR: no gate, secrets, scrubber or updater.

Holo coworker card component: 3D tilt, flip, and static PNG fallback. Front face shows portrait image with CSS foil layer (linear + conic gradients) and engraved gold border. Back face shows name, category, "More motion" tag, and Pick button. Hover tilts ±12°, drag rotates Y-axis ±180°, Space/Enter flips. Reduced-motion disables animation; IntersectionObserver 0.25 threshold gates animation when off-screen. Integrated into CoworkerGrid (Coworkers page and onboarding pick step) with zero new npm dependencies (CSS-only foil and 2D canvas sparkle).

## What

- `src/components/HoloCard.tsx` (new) — React component managing flip state, visibility gating, portrait fallback, reduced-motion detection. Props: portrait, name, category, moreMotion, onPick, visible, reduced. ARIA labels, keyboard (Space/Enter flips, Tab reaches Pick), role="article".
- `src/components/holoCard.css` (new) — 3D perspective, flip animation (400–600ms), foil layer (linear + conic gradients driven by --glare-x/--glare-y CSS vars), engraved gold border (inset box-shadows, --oasis-needs-you + --oasis-rim tokens), tilt transform-origin (pointer math), reduced-motion (no transition, instant flip).
- `src/lib/holoCardState.ts` (new) — useHoloCardState hook (no React deps): tracks pointer events (tilt ±12° X/Y), left-button drag (Y-axis ±180°), IntersectionObserver (0.25 threshold), visibilitychange, matchMedia prefers-reduced-motion. Renders tilt/glare only if visible AND hovered AND !reduced. Sparkle: one 2D canvas generated at module load as data-URL (~50KB, reused per page).
- `tests/holoCard.test.tsx` (new) — vitest + jsdom + RTL: render front face, back face on flip, static PNG when invisible/not-hovered, reduced-motion instant flip, keyboard focus, Pick button interaction (8 tests).
- `tests/holoCardState.test.ts` (new) — unit tests: visibility gating, hover gating, reduced-motion, flip persistence, pointer move updates tilt/glare, visibilitychange API, IntersectionObserver entry (8 tests).
- `src/components/CoworkerGrid.tsx` (edit) — wrap each card in HoloCard with visible/reduced props from parent tracking. onPick callback unchanged. StatusLine remains below HoloCard.
- `src/styles/coworkers.css` (edit) — remove conflicting coworker__card styles; ensure HoloCard container takes grid space (width 100% or inherit), preserve grid layout and spacing.
- `CHANGELOG.md` (edit) — one line at top of ## Unreleased: `T50: Holo coworker cards with tilt, flip, and static fallback on Coworkers page and onboarding pick step (#232).`
- `tests/holoCardWire.test.tsx` (new) — integration: CoworkerGrid renders HoloCard per pack, Pick calls parent onPick, IntersectionObserver gates visible/static, PickCoworkerStep renders HoloCards, StatusLine below card (5 tests).

## Open

Decision #159 provisional picks — Braden may amend at PR:
- **Tilt driver:** v1 uses custom pointer→rotateX/rotateY math (no npm dep, ±12° hover clamp, snap-back) → amend to Three.js with exact pin (e.g., `three@0.180.0`), requires #112 approval and idle/bundle impact measurement.
- **Drag-to-rotate:** v1 includes left-mouse drag Y-axis ±180° (snaps back if not flipped) → amend to remove drag (Space/Enter flip only) or extend to ±360° continuous.
- **Foil layer:** v1 is CSS-only (linear + conic gradients, sparkle from 2D canvas data-URL at load) → amend to procedural shader (holocloth), baked texture, or omit foil.
- **Gold border:** v1 is CSS engraved (box-shadow inset layers, Lantern gold tokens) → amend to guillocheJS guilloche texture, SVG path, or flat border.
- **IntersectionObserver threshold:** v1 uses 0.25 (25% in viewport) → amend to 0 (any pixel), 0.5 (half), or 1.0 (fully visible).

## Mutation check

Each mutant applied one at a time to the source, suite run, then reverted (`.swarm-manifests/t50-mutants.json`):

- (a) hidden page/card keeps animating — `src/lib/holoCardState.ts`: Remove visibility gate: const live = seen && !hidden (ignore visible prop) → 2 tests fail, e.g. `useHoloCardState > visible=false: no animation whatever the pointer does`
- (b) back face shows before flip — `src/lib/holoCardState.ts`: Make card start flipped: useState(true) instead of useState(false) → 13 tests fail, e.g. `HoloCard > back face shows name, category and the More motion tag only when moreMotion`
- (c) static fallback missing — `src/components/HoloCard.tsx`: Always render 3D tree: const fallback = false (remove static fallback) → 4 tests fail, e.g. `HoloCard > visible=false: static fallback img, no 3D tree, hover cannot wake it`

No survivors. Plus `loading="lazy"`/`decoding="async"` on the portrait restored with its original assertion (#203).
